correctness.rationale: All-parameter proof rules out isolated colors for welfare optima, uses edge-sum domination when the four-vertex cut has at least two edges, and derives strict boundary-vertex best-response inequalities on P4 when the cut has one edge. Rational dynamic programming uniquely identifies the five-path welfare optimum and a strict profitable deviation. Complete enumeration of all 32 profiles verifies the three pure equilibria and exact maximum Nash welfare; verifier reports 3,195 supplementary small-graph grid cases, not claimed as a continuum proof.

value.rationale: Exact smallest-agent threshold is a motivated finite structural boundary for when collective-welfare optimal coordination ceases to be self-enforcing in a canonical positive network game. The sharp witness already occurs on a tree, with only three rational preference values, and creates a concrete nonzero planner-to-equilibrium welfare wedge. The lower bound holds uniformly for a continuum of heterogeneous preferences, not only a finite search grid.
